items.title: Make SIL forecasting parse the live v3 ledger and fail closed on incomplete category coverage
items.evidence: The freshly rendered startup brief reports Projected 0/1000 while the source ledger and PROJECT_STATUS are 1000/1000. parseSilHistory only accepts Total on the heading line and numbered category rows, but S108-S115 use a separate Total line and unnumbered rows.
items.recipe: Parse both canonical heading/total layouts and both category-table layouts; normalize legacy/current labels; only emit a forecast when all ten categories are present; add fixtures spanning old and current formats plus a regression asserting S115 forecasts 1000 rather than zero.

L2.recipe: Format-tolerant parser, completeness invariant, and focused tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus renderer self-validation against PROJECT_STATUS.

items.title: Turn every external launch blocker into a typed, mechanically mirrored proof contract
items.evidence: PROJECT_STATUS has six external blockers, while LAUNCH_PROOFS defines only auth email, Stripe, friend beta, and affiliate coverage. Brevo delivery, Supabase deployment, and production capture configuration are not canonical proof objects; the ledger records mirroredInLaunchProofs=false but still passes --check.
items.recipe: Add typed proof entries for Brevo delivery, Supabase quota/function deployment, and capture public-key configuration; make ledger --check fail when a blocker is unmirrored; expose deterministic coverage counts and regression-test classification/mirroring without completing any real-world proof.

L1.recipe: Add the three missing proof entries.

L2.recipe: Add completeness validation and focused tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus deterministic coverage metrics and launch-gate wiring.

items.title: Budget the real initial dependency graph and async-chunk ceiling, not a tiny filename heuristic
items.evidence: The launch gate prints main chunk index=5.4KB while the build also emits App=203.7KB, vendor=177.3KB, Supabase=215.7KB, and Sentry=493.6KB. The current checker explicitly ignores vendor/analytics chunks and cannot distinguish static initial imports from lazy chunks.
items.recipe: Emit a Vite manifest; traverse static imports from the application entry; enforce raw initial-graph, per-chunk, and lazy-chunk ceilings with explicit largest-chunk diagnostics; export pure graph helpers and add synthetic-manifest regression tests.

L2.recipe: Manifest-based initial graph plus async ceiling and tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus deterministic diagnostics and environment overrides.

items.title: Give every Promo Advisor verdict an inspectable counterfactual decision receipt
items.axis: AI integration / decision UX / responsible engagement
items.evidence: normalizeAdvisorResult accepts assumptions and the UI can display them, but SYSTEM_PROMPT does not request assumptions. Neither rule nor AI results identify missing inputs or concrete conditions that would change the verdict, leaving confidence non-actionable.
items.recipe: Extract a shared pure result normalizer; require bounded assumptions, missingInputs, and sensitivityTriggers from the AI; derive honest rule-engine receipts from parsed terms; render a compact accessible Decision Receipt; preserve these fields when saving a workflow; add Deno normalization tests and React interaction coverage.

L2.recipe: Shared receipt normalizer, AI/rule parity, and tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus workflow persistence and accessible counterfactual interaction.
